mapper.sql: id, stat_id, stat_date, day1, day3, day7, day14, day30, new_user_count, active_user_count, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hm_user_retention_stats ( stat_id, stat_date, day1, day3, day7, day14, day30, new_user_count, active_user_count, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{statId}, #{statDate}, #{day1}, #{day3}, #{day7}, #{day14}, #{day30}, #{newUserCount}, #{activeUserCount}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE hm_user_retention_stats SET day1 = #{day1}, day3 = #{day3}, day7 = #{day7}, day14 = #{day14}, day30 = #{day30}, new_user_count = #{newUserCount}, active_user_count = #{activeUserCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hm_user_retention_stats WHERE stat_date = #{statDate} LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS new_user_count FROM hm_user WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY stat_date ASC

SELECT DATE(timestamp) AS stat_date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_user_count FROM hm_hug_record WHERE timestamp >= #{startDate} AND timestamp < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(timestamp) ORDER BY stat_date ASC
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM hm_hug_record WHERE timestamp >= #{startDate} AND timestamp < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
